title: How working together looks
subtitle: Three steps. After the first call you know where you stand — and it costs you nothing.

steps.title: The call
steps.description: You describe what hurts in plain words: a slow system, worry about your data, hardware that remembers the last decade. I listen and tell you straight away whether it's my kind of work. If it isn't — I'll point you to someone who can help.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.description: I look into the server, the backups and the network, and write down what you have, what's a risk and what to do first. You get a concrete plan with prices — one you could take to someone else.

steps.title: Ongoing care
steps.description: I take it over for good: backups, updates and a hardware replacement plan, with a 24h response. The server, data and hardware stay your property — you can take them back with the documentation at any time.
